disposition_reason: Ten cow-milk-based powdered infant formulas (three batches each) sold in Rio de Janeiro were analysed by ICP-MS for macro and trace minerals including Cr, Co, Mn, Cu, Zn, Fe, Mo and Se (Table 2). Lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury were not measured, and soy-based formulas were excluded by design.
disposition_locator: Table 2, p. 6 (rotated table, read with pdftotext -raw)

study.design: Retail product survey with label compliance and estimated daily intake
study.origin: Formulas from three manufacturers registered with ANVISA (Brazil); production origin not stated
study.market: Commercial establishments in the city of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
study.method: Overnight HNO3 digestion at room temperature then 100 C for about 4 h; ICP-MS (PerkinElmer NexION 300X)
study.lod_text: LOD and LOQ per element in Supplementary Table 5 (not in the PDF); Se LOQ 0.0015 mg/100 g stated in text
study.qa: CRMs ERM-BD150 skimmed milk powder and NIST SRM 1549 non-fat milk powder (Table 1 recoveries)
